I John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands, herebydeclare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land AcquisitionAct, that the lands described below are needed for a public purposeand will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of lands shown as Lot Nos. 1 to 5 in Advance TracingNo. MR/THG/RDA/2016/421 and dated 05.10.2016 prepared by theSenior Superintandent of Surveys on behalf of the Surveyor - General,situated in the village of Aparakka in the Minor Division of GangabadaPaththuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thihagoda inMatara District in Southern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 1 – Dombagahakoratuwa – Extent: 0.0026HectareNorth: Dombagahakoratuwa claimed by A. C. Senarath Yapa, Roadand Lot No 6; East: Lot No 6; South: Lot No 2, Paragahawattaclaimed by C. W. Jayasekara and Dombagahakoratuwa claimed byA. C. Senarath Yapa; West: Dombagahakoratuwa claimed by A. C.Senarath Yapa.

02. Lot No. 2 – Paragahawatta – Extent: 0.0028 HectareNorth: Lot Nos 1 and 6; East: Lot No 6; South: Lot No 3,Paragahawatta claimant cannot be found and Paragahawatta claimedby C. W. Jayasekara; West: Paragahawatta claimed by C. W.Jayasekara and Dombagahakoratuwa claimed by A. C. Senarath Yapa.

03. Lot No. 3 – Paragahawatta– Extent: 0.0083 HectareNorth: Lot Nos 2 and 6; East: Lot No 6; South: Lot No 4, Kopiwattaclaimant cannot be found and Paragahawatta claimant cannot befound; West: Paragahawatta claimant cannot be found andParagahawatta claimed by C. W. Jayasekara.

04. Lot No. 4 – Kopiwatta – Extent: 0.0020 HectareNorth: Paragahawatta claimant cannot be found, Lot Nos 3 and 6;East: Lot No 6; South: Lot No 5, Kopiwatta claimed by Nandathilakakoralage and Nandana Koralage; West: Kopiwatta claimant cannotbe found.

05. Lot No. 5 – Kopiwatta – Extent: 0.0054 HectareNorth: Kopiwatta claimant cannot be found, Lot Nos 4 and 6;East: Lot No 6; South: Road and Kopiwatta claimed by NandathilakaKoralage and Nandana Koralage;West: Kopiwatta claimed byNandathilaka Koralage and Nandana koralage.
John A. E. Amarathunga,Minister of Lands.
